title: Share one promise per deopt stub site
motivation: `ElideUnforcedPromise` turns a promise that is never forced into a stub whose body is only `deopt 0 []`. The C code still built a full promise for each execution of the stub site: the external pointer to its code, its data vector, the local-data raw vector, the `PROMSXP`, and one cons on the tracking list. permute_fake made 69,280 such promises per call, none forced, and queens and storage also made many stubs.
solution: `Promise#isDeoptStub` recognizes the stub body, and `Fir2CCompiler` compiles a stub site to one `PROMSXP` that the promise's init function makes with the new `Fir_mk_stub_promise` (`PRENV = Rsh_ElidedEnv`) and stores in pool slot 2. Each execution reads it with `Fir_const(cp, 2)`, and a CFG whose promises are all shared stubs needs no tracking list. A stub whose expression is a symbol stays a per-execution promise if the version may have a regular environment, because `missing` reads `PRENV` of such a promise. Also in this range: a fix that keeps a pushed frame and each saved elided parent in protect slots of the activation, which the env operations `REPROTECT`; before it, the first block's `UNPROTECT` released the frame.

files.client/rsh/src/fir2c/runtime.c: Factors out `Fir_promise_code`, adds `Fir_mk_stub_promise`, and removes the `PROTECT`/`UNPROTECT` of the frame from `Fir_push_env`, `Fir_pop_env` and `Fir_materialize_env`.
files.client/rsh/src/fir2c/runtime.h: Declares `Fir_mk_stub_promise` and documents that the env push, pop and materialize do not protect, because the caller keeps the frame in its own slots.
files.repo-map.md: Updates the `ElideUnforcedPromise.java` line and adds the examples `promise_shared_stub.R` and `subscript_default_method.R`.
files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir/ir/e: Adds `isDeoptStub`, which tests that the body is only `deopt 0 []`.
files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir/opt/: Uses `Promise#isDeoptStub` in place of its own inline test of the stub shape.
files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir2c/Fi: Emits one shared promise per stub site in pool slot 2, does not track it, and keeps frame and saved parents in activation protect slots.
